newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - HudCon to raise A$120 mln with issue.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - HudCon to raise A$120 mln with issue.

text.p: Investment group Hudson Conway Ltd announced on Monday plans to issue A$120 million of five-year unsecured notes with detachable five-year options.

The issue, which aims to give the company greater financial flexibility, will be fully underwritten by Prudential Bache Securities and will be placed with institutional investors, chairman Sir Roderick Carnegie told the annual meeting.
The notes carry a coupon of nine percent and mature on November 30, 2001.
The options have an exercise price of A$22.50 and exercisable at six monthly intervals from July 1998.

The options expire on October 31, 2001 and their issue must be approved by at a shareholders meeting, tentatively set for November 14. The notes and options are to be listed separately on the Australian Stock Exchange.
The proceeds from the issue would also be used for working capital and retire debt, Carnegie said.

"It will provide the company with finacial flexibility ... to enable the group to pursue major projects," Carnegie told the meeting, adding that Hudson Conway was considering major projects in Australia.
Hudson Conway shares closed steady at A$17.92 on Friday.
